subject: Please share your NIMBLE use case

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Please share your NIMBLE use case
parts:
Hi nimble-users,

We, the NIMBLE development team, are interested in hearing about your use cases or potential use cases for NIMBLE. If you’ve tried it, or have a problem for which you’ve given it a look (whether it worked for you or not), or have an idea of what you’d like to be able to do with it in the future, please email me directly (or to the list if you prefer).

And by the way, we have a major new release coming along soon. It includes a bunch of new features and faster building of models and algorithms.

Thanks
Perry
